prologue.title: BOOKWAR
prologue.panel_0:
Once, speech rang throughout the world.
People wrote books, named things, sang songs.
Letters lived in every home, in every word.
prologue.panel_1:
Letters are weapon and shield.
Letters are value.
Letters are everything.
prologue.panel_2:
Then came the Keeper of the Ban —
an ancient being, born of the fear
of the power of the word. He laid a curse.
prologue.panel_3:
The letters were scattered across the dark lands,
beyond the Bright Valley.
The power to speak and write was lost.
prologue.panel_4:
People could no longer understand one another.
No language, no words —
only chaos and silence.
prologue.panel_5:
The sorcerer's minions use only the letters
that serve them, giving them their own meanings.
No one can check — all books are destroyed.
prologue.panel_6:
The world will drown in lies —
lest a hero gather the letters,
the hypocrites and liars shall prevail.
prologue.panel_7:
You are the hero. You set out to reclaim the alphabet,
to restore the truth.

LETTERS ARE TRUTH. Gather them all.

Собери три точки — и ты сможешь заговори: Gather three dots and you will be able to speak. Press E next to a dot to pick it up.
Когда соберёшь три точки, они превратятс: Once you have three dots, they become an ellipsis. With it, you can speak to monsters.
Отлично! У тебя есть многоточие. Теперь: Excellent! You have an ellipsis. Now you can speak.
Попробуй подойти к монстру и нажать T, ч: Try approaching a monster and pressing T to begin a dialogue.
Слова могут быть сильнее оружия. Убеди м: Words can be stronger than weapons. Convince a monster to leave, and it will retreat.
Ты нашёл букву! Это великое событие. Бук: You found a letter! A great event. Letters are weapon, shield, and currency at once.
Гласные — атака. Согласные — защита. Наж: Vowels attack. Consonants defend. Press I to open your inventory and view your letters.
Я знаю, где спрятаны буквы. Но подсказки: I know where letters are hidden. But hints cost dots. 5 dots for one hint.
Говорят, к северу от деревни спрятана бу: They say the letter А is hidden north of the village...
You don't have enough dots. Come back later.

lore.dark_oaks: Dark Oaks — ancient forest where roots hide forgotten letters.
lore.mossy_lowlands: Mossy Lowlands — damp stones, moss, and the betrayal of swamp elders.
lore.rotten_swamps: Rotten Swamps — bogs from which none return. Almost none.
lore.swamp_lights: Swamp Lights — false fires lead into the mire. Stay on the path.
lore.stony_wastes: Stony Wastes — wind and dry stone. Words echo hollowly here.
lore.ash_plains: Ash Plains — the scar of an ancient fire that devoured a library.
lore.crystal_grottos: Crystal Grottos — underground crystals store echoes of words.
lore.dark_cathedral: Dark Cathedral — a grim place of power where the Ban gained its voice.
lore.forgotten_ruins: Ruins of Forgotten Words — fragments of language no one can read now.
lore.misty_grove: Misty Grove — low fog hides those who still remember.
lore.grey_forest: Grey Forest — dense, nearly lightless. Here, one speaks in whispers.
lore.wind_pass: Wind Pass — the wind carries off any unanchored letters.
lore.ice_pincers: Ice Pincers — a narrow pass where words freeze on your lips.
lore.mountain_caves: Mountain Caves — the first dungeons, home to dark letters.
lore.deep_mines: Deep Mines — abandoned diggings where rare consonants were carved out.
lore.catacombs_silence: Catacombs of Silence — corridors where even echoes fear to repeat.
lore.vaults_oblivion: Vaults of Oblivion — ancient tombs of fallen words.
lore.underground_river: Underground River — black water sweeps away those who falter.
lore.flooded_temple: Flooded Temple — a half-drowned hall where letters were once prayed to.
lore.ruined_library: Ruined Library — the wreckage of knowledge, gnawed by the Ban.
lore.broken_bridge: Broken Bridge — across a chasm that was not here before.
lore.abandoned_village: Abandoned Village — empty houses hold the silence of the departed.
lore.old_citadel: Old Citadel — a crumbling fortress where letters were defended and fell.
lore.shadow_fortress: Shadow Fortress — inhabited by dark forces that feed on speech.
lore.black_tower: Black Tower — the tallest, ringed by eternal darkness.
lore.throne_void: Throne of Void — an empty throne crushes the will of any who enter.
lore.hall_mirrors: Hall of Mirrors — mirrors distort both words and those who speak them.
lore.labyrinth_fear: Labyrinth of Fear — shifting corridors where even letters get lost.
lore.chambers_ban: Chambers of Ban — here the forbidden knowledge of the alphabet is kept.
lore.throne_keeper: Throne of the Keeper — the penultimate zone. He is waiting.
lore.well_of_letters: Well of Letters — the source of the alphabet. Here it began — here it ends.

manual.content_controls:
GOAL OF THE GAME
Recover all letters of the alphabet scattered across the dark lands. Letters are weapon, armor and currency at once.

CONTROLS
- WASD / arrows — move the hero
- E — pick up an item (dots, letters)
- I — open / close the bag (inventory)
- T — speak (if a monster is near and you have "...")
- Space — pause
- ? (button on the right) — this manual

On screen there are also buttons: D-pad at the bottom left, action buttons on the right (Take/Bag/Speech). Playable with both mouse and keyboard.

BRIGHT VALLEY
You start without a single letter. Walk the valley, collect "." dots from the ground. Three dots combine into an ellipsis "..." — your only way to speak with monsters at the start.
manual.content_letters:
TOKENS ARE A RESOURCE
The small colored letters lying on the ground are TOKENS (currency).
Collect them: 3 tokens combine into an ellipsis "..." (speech), and from tokens grow big LETTERS — your weapon and armor.

BIG LETTERS IN FRAMES = WEAPON AND ARMOR
The large framed letters you pick up are combat cards. Frame color = role:
- RED frame (vowel) — WEAPON. Deals damage to the enemy.
- BLUE frame (consonant) — ARMOR. Raises a shield that absorbs damage.
- PURPLE frame (hard/soft signs) — boosts the next attack or defense ×1.5.

LETTERS = SPEED AND POWER
Position in the alphabet = speed (1 — slowest, last — lightning fast).
The SLOWER the letter — the STRONGER the strike/shield. The faster — the weaker, but it acts first.

VOWELS — ATTACK (red frame).
CONSONANTS — DEFENSE (blue frame).
Hard sign — boosts the next consonant defense ×1.5.
Soft sign — boosts the next vowel attack ×1.5.

LETTER LEVEL = number of copies collected. Damage/shield = power × level.
1 copy = level 1. 3 copies = level 3. Letters are NOT spent in battle — the level is permanent.

EXAMPLE: the first letter of the alphabet is powerful but acts last. The last letter is weak but strikes first.
manual.content_combat:
WHO TO FIGHT, WHO TO TALK TO
- "?" (question) — patrols, NEUTRAL. Does not attack. TALK to it (needs "...").
  After the talk — a coin flip: it becomes an ally (green) or stays neutral (gray).
- "!" (exclamation) — AGGRESSOR. Chases and attacks. Only FIGHT it (or flee).
- Drawn creatures (Forest Beast, Dark Wolf, Shadeling) — wild beasts, always fight.
- The sorcerer's evil minions: Sign and Sound — strong hooded humanoid bosses.

HOW TO FIGHT (card combat)
When an "!" catches you — a battle opens. You and the enemy both have HP.
- Choose a WEAPON (red vowel letter) — to strike.
- Or ARMOR (blue consonant letter) — to raise a shield.
- Press "Confirm Turn" (or Space).

ONE LETTER — ONCE PER BATTLE
In a single battle each letter (and spell) can be used ONLY ONCE.
Per turn you may play several DIFFERENT letters, but each burns out until the battle ends.
A new battle resets everything. Build tactics: powerful letters — for later, weak ones — now.
(Letters are NOT lost forever — your level is permanent; spending is only within one battle.)

TURN ORDER — BY SPEED
Fast letters act first; slow ones — last, but hit harder.
- A vowel strikes the enemy. If the enemy has a shield — it breaks through it first.
- A consonant adds a shield to you. The shield absorbs incoming damage.
- HP <= 0 = defeat.

VICTORY -> drop of 1-3 of the enemy's letters into your bag.
DEFEAT -> return to the region start with half HP.
There is an "Auto" button — the AI plays the rounds — and "Flee" — to leave the battle.
manual.content_dialogue:
ELLIPSIS "..." — SPEECH
Collect 3 "." dots -> they combine into "..." (ellipsis). It is your ability to speak.

DIALOGUE WITH A MONSTER
- Approach a monster.
- Press T (or the "Speech" button).
- One ellipsis is spent.
- The monster's line appears.

RECRUITING (50/50)
When the dialogue closes (E/T or you walked away) — a coin flip:
- Success: the monster becomes your ally (green) and follows you.
- Failure: the monster becomes neutral (gray) and retreats.

MONSTER KINDS
- "?" (question) — patrols, neutral. You can talk to it.
- "!" (exclamation) — aggressive, chases and attacks.

HIDING
Stand on a dark tile (tree, water, stone, fence) — the monster loses sight of you and starts searching. On grass and path you cannot hide.
manual.content_spells:
SPELLS — WORDS FROM LETTERS
Letters are spell components. Gather the right letters and you fold them into words — stronger than single letters.

MAIN ROSTER (alphabetical)
- BANG (B+A+N+G) — amplified attack, double damage.
- ZAP — lightning, pierces the enemy shield.
- BOW — ranged shot, no retaliation.
- HEAL — restores 40 HP.
- RUN — dodge the next attack.
- BURN — sets the enemy on fire for 3 turns.
- WAR — threefold strike, massive damage.

HOW TO CAST
In battle, besides letter buttons, buttons of unlocked spells appear. Choose a spell instead of a letter.
EACH spell is also once per battle. Letters are NOT permanently spent on casting.

SPELL SPEED = speed of the slowest letter in the word. Powerful words are slow.
Recipes are unlocked at the Word Smith (in the village/citadel).
manual.content_crafting:
LETTER CRAFTING — TRANSFORMATION
In the bag you can turn one letter into another by adding a modifier (soft sign or apostrophe).

RECIPES
- B + soft -> P  (70% success)
- P + soft -> B  (70%)
- F + soft -> V  (70%)
- V + soft -> F  (70%)
- M + soft -> N  (70%)
- N + soft -> M  (70%)
- SHCH + ' -> SH  (70%)
- SH + ' -> SHCH  (70%)
- S + soft -> Z  (60%)
- D + soft -> T  (60%)

OUTCOME
- Success: the modifier is spent, the target letter is added (+1 level).
- Failure: the donor letter (modifier) is LOST with no result.

Open the "Crafting" tab in the bag, choose a source letter and a modifier, press "Transform".
manual.content_glossary:
GLOSSARY — CORE CONCEPTS

LETTERS (alphabet letters) — the ONLY resource. Simultaneously:
- CURRENCY — the cost of purchases/spell unlocks and trades.
- WEAPON — vowels deal damage to the enemy.
- ARMOR — consonants create a shield that absorbs damage.
- SPELL COMPONENT — words-spells are folded from letters.
Letter level = number of copies collected. Letters are NOT spent in battle.

DOTS "." — the basic resource. Lie on the ground in the Bright Valley.
ELLIPSIS "..." — SPEECH. Collect 3 dots -> they combine into "...".
It is the only way to start talking to a monster early in the game.

DIALOGUE AND RECRUITING
- "?" — patrol, neutral. Talk to it (spends "...").
- "!" — aggressor, attacks.
- After the dialogue — a 50/50 flip: the monster becomes either an Ally (green, follows you),
  or Neutral (gray, retreats). Recruited monsters are your gang.

HIDING — stand on a dark tile (tree/water/stone/fence) and the monster loses you.

REGION VICTORY — every monster killed, recruited OR neutralized.

SPELLS (main, alphabetical)
BANG · ZAP · BOW · HEAL · RUN · BURN · WAR
(Details on the "Spells" tab. Partially implemented so far.)
